'''Dezdarmu''' was a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a champion of his tribe during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Allied with the Republic, he and his tribe captured and attempted to destroy the [[Dorn Base power station|power station]] supplying the Empire's [[Dorn Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperial forces.<ref name="Mission" />
